fundamental.summary: KLAC shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 44 days—insufficient smart money alignment for actionable signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (233.28) indicates extreme market stress, CPI event imminent (0 days), and earnings in 44 days create binary event risk; unfavourable environment for tech equities.
